prompts.courier: Use case: identity-preserve compositing edit. Create ONE high-resolution lossless transparent RGBA full-body equipped character sprite for Swarm Song, at highest useful native resolution. Image 1 is the approved clean standing bunny EDIT TARGET, image 2 is the accessory design reference. Preserve exactly the bunny's cream watercolor print, ear shapes/tilts, face, blush, open smile, huge head and extremely short legs, outline weight, and body proportions. Do not redesign or elongate anatomy. Only adapt the paw contact where needed and integrate the specified equipment naturally into the illustration. Keep face fully visible. Equipment must have correct perspective, scale, occlusion and contact rather than look like an independent sticker pasted over the body. One continuous warm-white external die-cut outline around the combined silhouette; no internal white sticker borders at body/prop contacts. No external glow, ground shadow, text, labels, scenery, checkerboard, or extra props. Fully transparent outside the sticker, generous padding on all sides, no clipped ears or feet. Equipment: Courier wearing the small ochre leather satchel in image 2. Its thin brown strap runs naturally from the shoulder across the torso to the opposite hip; rear strap disappears behind the shoulder. The small bag rests upright against the hip, follows body perspective, brass button and tiny blank teal patch retained. Strap must not cross face or float from chin. Both feet clearly visible; bag small enough not to engulf torso. No envelope yet, no goggles.
